acceptanceRules.multipleTesting: One-sided Student t test on UTC-day block mean returns with Bonferroni adjustment across all 12,012 searched configurations.
acceptanceRules.dependenceAwareCheck: Deterministic UTC-day block bootstrap for the predefined top 20 robustness-ranked configurations; qualifying lower bound must exceed zero.

protectedFinalEvaluation.rule: Evaluate only frozen finalists that pass every development rule. Performance is inspected once after the window closes and a row-level audit passes. Operational health may be monitored without performance metrics.

dataset.checks: Selected chunk SHA-256, row counts, bounds, ordering, duplicate/conflict rejection, and every eligible UTC second verified.

evidenceLimitations: All searched ticks were previously viewed development data.
Historical public prices are not executable account proposals or fills.
Payouts and entry delays are sensitivity assumptions, not observed historical contract terms.
Bonferroni correction covers this frozen 12,012-configuration batch but cannot reconstruct every informal prior project search.
The prospective final holdout has not occurred; no candidate can qualify for controlled demo validation from this batch alone.
